messages:
Maria: Heads-up — VectorWorks asked to split their renewal across two legal entities. They want Entity A to get the PO (70%) and Entity B to pay by card (30%). Need to confirm billing contacts, vendor codes, and signer authority.
Jonah: Can they keep the same total ARR? any change to term/price?
Maria: No change to price or term, still 12 months. Just a payment routing/contract signature nuance.
Susan: Finance: we can emit two invoices, but we need vendor codes and tax IDs for both. Also their procurement asked for net30, our default renewal template is net45 — will they accept net45?
Maria: They asked strongly for net30 to match their OSS cycle. Asking them if they can accept net45 for Entity A at least.
Liam: Legal: split-signature is doable but we need delegated signer confirmation for Entity B (card payer). If Entity A is signing with PO, that's standard. Prefer an addendum that maps invoices to payment entity and confirms delegated signer for Entity B.
Kevin: CS to collect: (1) billing contact + email for both entities, (2) vendor codes, (3) tax IDs, (4) delegated signer name + email + title for Entity B.
Maria: I'm on the call with them at 11am PT, will request those.
BillingBot: Draft invoices created: INV-2026-1001 (Entity A, 70%, draft), INV-2026-1002 (Entity B, 30%, draft). PO placeholder PO-45872.
Jonah: If they push back on net45 we can make exception to net30 for renewals but need approval from Finance + Revenue ops. @Susan can you confirm?
Susan: I can approve net30 for Entity B only if card is used and payment clears before we apply service. For Entity A PO/net45 we can leave as standard. Will need CFO signoff for a policy exception for renewals > $200k.
Liam: On the DOCS side — we should use a short addendum: "Payment Routing & Delegated Signer Addendum". Template: 1) defines Entity A/B, 2) maps invoice numbers, 3) confirms delegated signer for Entity B, 4) confirms that total consideration unchanged. I can drop a draft by EOD.
Maria: Great. During call they committed to provide vendor codes and delegated signer email. I'll capture and post here.
Kevin: Once we have delegated signer email, we should run the Docusign delegated signer flow: template id ds-template-rr-02. Also include a field for "PO number for Entity A".
Maria: Sending customer follow-up now.
(10 minutes later)
Maria: Customer replied: vendor codes: VEC-A-001 for Entity A, VEC-B-002 for Entity B. Tax IDs: A: 12-3456789, B: 98-7654321. Delegated signer for Entity B: Karen Liu, karen.liu@vectorworks.com, CFO. She confirmed authority. They also agreed to net30 for Entity B and net45 for Entity A.
Susan: Perfect — finance can proceed with split invoices and net terms as described. I will flag the renewal for policy exception record (net30 on Entity B).
Liam: I'll prep the addendum and route for signature. Docusign flow: sign order Entity A signer -> Entity B delegated signer (Karen) -> Redwood standard countersign. Template draft id: ds-template-rr-02 (will update fields).
BillingBot: Updated invoices: INV-2026-1001 (Entity A, 70%, status: pending PO PO-45872), INV-2026-1002 (Entity B, 30%, status: ready for card capture).
Jonah: Once PO is uploaded and card charged for Entity B, we can mark renewal as executed. Any blockers?
Kevin: Need PO upload to billing portal (link: https://billing.redwood.example/upload) and confirmation of card payment. Also need the signed addendum.
Maria: I'll own PO upload and confirm with Karen for the card payment window. Will post final attachments here when done.
(Next day)
Maria: Update — PO uploaded (PO-45872 PDF attached). Karen completed card payment. Addendum signed via DocuSign and countersigned by our legal. All good to close.
Susan: Recorded in billing system, invoices issued. Marking as completed in renewal tracker.
Liam: Saved executed addendum to Contract repo: /contracts/vectorworks/renewal-2026-signed.pdf
Maria: Awesome team, thanks :tada: Closing thread.
